steps.name: apply-stage18c1-python-runtime-fallback-contract
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=22b5b3e14993b163da1f18fb7a938348c3b1a623; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; rm -f warnings.txt; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage18/apply_stage18c1_python_fallback_contract.py > /tmp/apply-stage18c1-python-fallback.py; .venv/bin/python /tmp/apply-stage18c1-python-fallback.py; .venv/bin/python -m ruff check --fix tools/ml/climate_runtime.py tests/test_climate_runtime.py; .venv/bin/python -m ruff format tools/ml/climate_runtime.py tests/test_climate_runtime.py; git diff --check; git status --short

steps.name: focused-stage18c1-runtime-fallback-tests
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_climate_runtime.py tests/test_climate_benchmark.py tests/test_climate_input.py; .venv/bin/python -m ruff check tools/ml/climate_runtime.py tests/test_climate_runtime.py; .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check tools/ml/climate_runtime.py tests/test_climate_runtime.py; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --target climate_v6_tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests -R '^climate_v6_tests$' --output-on-failure; git diff --check
